title: Discipline that bows before it conquers
subtitle: For when discipline is becoming control instead of contentment
description: Move from outward rigor into the harder discipline Guru Nanak names: contentment, humility, shared belonging, and the mind conquered before the world is judged.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The real ascetic work is not display but a mind brought under truth, humble enough to see all people as one brotherhood.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Before tightening another rule, ask whether it is making the mind humbler, more content, and less eager to defeat someone else.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey begins where visible discipline can still leave the ego intact and follows the shabad toward contentment, humility, and the inward conquest that changes how the whole world is seen.
evidence.turn: Discipline becomes holy when it bows, gathers the human family into view, and turns its first strength against the restless mind.
evidence.practicalImplication: Use the five steps to test whether your rule is producing humility and remembrance, then let one concrete act of contentment matter more than appearing spiritually severe.
